verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community user who chose 1Password over Bitwarden citing its 'audit results, documented architecture'. That implies audit results are available, but no first-party page shows published independent audits. The end-to-end encryption claim is a related but different point and earns no credit here. missing for 10: first-party publication of independent audit reports, audits specifically covering the sync protocol, auditor names and dates or scope, any corroborating independent source beyond a single comment.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol

citations.quote: Reasons: audit results, documented architecture and good Linux support.
